title: Natural boss arrivals: 'You feel an evil presence…', slime rain ends in King Slime, rare surface King Slime, mechanical warnings
player_outcome: Without any summon, a ready player may hear 'You feel an evil presence watching you...' at nightfall before the Eye arrives. Slime Rain ends with King Slime after 150 kills (75 once he is beaten). King Slime can rarely wander in on the outer surface. In hardmode, nights may open with 'This is going to be a terrible night...' and similar warnings.
design: EventDef additions (src/Strata.Core/Content/Defs/EventDef.cs): SpawnBoss (enemy id), KillGoalAfterFlag {Flag, Goal} and Group (string; at most one event per group starts per roll).
For SpawnBoss events, Duration is the countdown. When TicksLeft reaches 0, EventDirector spawns the boss near the LocalPlayer instead of ending with an end message.

EventDirector.Tick: on a SpawnBoss countdown hitting 0, if no creature of that id lives and its boss flag is unset, spawn it. Fliers go 20 m away and 12 m up along the player's facing; ground bosses 12 m up so they fall in. Then end the event silently. The state persists through the existing EventStateModel (TicksLeft).
EventDirector.Roll: set ctx.PlayerDefense (max over players, as PlayerMaxLife is set) and skip events whose Group already started this roll.
EventDirector.OnKilled: the effective goal is KillGoalAfterFlag.Goal when that flag is set.
ConditionContext.CentreDistance: 0 at the world centre and 1 at LandRadius, computed in WorldSession.ContextAt from cell X/Z and plan size. Add a 'worldRing' {min, max} condition.
Validator: SpawnBoss must be a non-minor boss; SpawnBoss events need Duration > 0 and no KillGoal; Group is a string.

Manual: new Tiny world, 'give life_crystal 5', equip armour to 10 defense, 'time 19.4', wait for dusk; message and Eye within 10 s when the roll hits. Force it with 'event evil_presence'.
risks: The Eye arriving at dusk every third night may annoy players. The chance is data (0.33 is Terraria's); the player can tune it.
The UI phase's invasion bar reads KillGoal and must use the effective goal. Expose EventDirector.GoalOf(ActiveEvent).
